title: Deep Learning-Based Segmentation of Peritoneal Cancer Index Regions from CT Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2604.27697v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Peritoneal metastases (PM) are staged using the surgically determined Peritoneal Cancer Index (sPCI), which requires invasive laparoscopic assessment. Although CT is routinely used for preoperative evaluation, imaging-based assessment of PM extent remains challenging and is often less structured than surgical PCI scoring. A recent consensus study defined radiological PCI (rPCI) regions for cross-sectional imaging. We present the first deep learning approach to automatically segment 13 rPCI regions on CT. 62 contrast-enhanced CT scans were retrospectively collected across the full PCI range. Each scan was annotated into non-overlapping rPCI regions by one researcher, reviewed by a second, with disagreements resolved by a radiologist. translated_title: 基于深度学习的CT影像腹膜癌指数区域分割
translated_abstract: 腹膜转移瘤(PM)通过手术确定的腹膜癌指数进行分期，这需要进行有创的腹腔镜评估。虽然CT常规用于术前评估，但基于影像的PM范围评估仍然具有挑战性，且通常不如手术PCI评分结构化。最近的一项共识研究定义了用于横断面成像的影像学PCI区域。我们提出了首个自动分割CT上13个rPCI区域的深度学习方法。回顾性收集了覆盖整个PCI范围的62个对比增强CT扫描。每个扫描由一名研究人员标注为不重叠的rPCI区域，由第二名研究人员审核，分歧由放射科医生解决。使用五折交叉验证，我们比较了nnU-Net和Swin UNETR，采用Dice系数、95百分位Hausdorff距离(HD95)和平均表面距离(ASD)进行评估。我们引入了一种解剖学约束的...
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于深度学习的CT影像腹膜癌指数区域自动分割方法，通过比较nnU-Net和Swin UNETR两种模型并结合解剖学约束，实现了对13个rPCI区域的自动分割，有望替代有创的腹腔镜评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first deep learning approach for automatic segmentation of 13 radiological Peritoneal Cancer Index (rPCI) regions on CT imaging, comparing nnU-Net and Swin UNETR with anatomical constraints, potentially replacing invasive laparoscopic assessment for peritoneal metastases staging.
